messages:
claire: Coastline Labs wants a joint perf/W deep-dive for their new ASIC. Need a minimal reproducible protocol and CSV outputs for marketplace listing. @devin @harry can you propose a concise sweep?
devin: Minimal sweep idea: models=newridge-7b + llama-13b; seqs=1024,2048; powercaps=100,140; quants=q4_0,q8_0. Collect avg power (5Hz), p50/p95/p99 lat, throughput_tps. Output: per-run CSV + raw nvml logs.
harry: Agree. Add kernel tuning knobs: isolcpus + nohz_full + rcu_nocbs. Example: isolcpus=6-11 nohz_full=6-11 rcu_nocbs=6-11. Also capture PMU counters for instructions/cycle.
claire: Acceptance criteria from partner: perf/W >= baseline+8% at 140W OR p99 < 300ms at seq=2048. They want a one-page summary for the marketplace listing and a reproducible script.
devin: I'll create run script template and tag runs with "coastline-2026-mar". Script writes to s3://redwood-bench/coastline/1722220000/ with checksums.
ops-bot: Bench slot reserved Fri 10:00-12:00 PT. Please confirm rack calibration.
bench-bot: JIRA INF-8120 created. Runbook draft page: internal/runbooks/coastline-labs-bench (draft).
harry: Dataset: 750 prompts staged at /data/bench/coastline/750.jsonl.gz. I'll validate CRC and upload.
claire: Action items: Devin -> scripts + CSV schema; Harry -> pmu scripts + dataset; Ops -> bench prep + power meters; I'll draft partner-facing one-pager and schedule Mon sync.
devin: Ack. Will include example CSV header: run_id,model,seq,powercap,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,throughput_tps,avg_power_w,perf_per_w.
harry: Ack. Will run a smoke today and attach logs.
claire: :thumbsup: Thanks team, looping in Coastline contact after runbook is stable.
